html:
This 3 day Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is designed for travelers who want a deeper, more immersive experience in the majestic landscapes of Ha Giang. Explore winding mountain passes, limestone formations, ethnic minority villages, waterfalls, and the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass. Ride with experienced Easy Riders and enjoy authentic local culture, homestays, and breathtaking scenery every moment of the journey.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (Sleeper Bus / Limousine Bus)

Pick-up at your hotel in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Travel to Ha Giang by luxury sleeper bus (private cabin) or limousine bus. Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30

Tour starts at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and Easy Riders will brief you on safety before the ride.

As soon as you enter the mountain region, the scenery transforms dramatically. You will stop at:

  • Bac Sum Pass – famous winding pass overlooking valleys

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Continue through the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, a UNESCO-recognized landscape filled with limestone mountains, rice terraces, and remote ethnic villages. See locals farming, working the hillsides, and living their traditional lifestyle.

Lunch in Yen Minh Town.

In the afternoon, visit:

  • Tham Ma Slope – iconic winding slope

  • Vuong Family Residence (H’Mong King Palace) – former home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, enjoy dinner, and explore the town at night.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Lung Ho – Mau Due – Du Gia Village

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, head toward the most iconic section of the Ha Giang Loop.

Experience:

  • Ma Pi Leng Pass – the “King of Passes” in Vietnam, with craggy cliffs and dramatic mountain walls

  • Sky Path Downhill Ride – offering panoramic views over the spectacular valley and emerald Nho Que River

This is considered the most breathtaking view in all of Ha Giang.

Continue riding through remote ethnic villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac Town (lunch stop)

In the afternoon, follow a scenic mountain trail toward Du Gia Village, home to 7 ethnic minority groups living harmoniously. This village is known for its peaceful ambiance, green rice fields, and preserved traditional culture.

Check in at a Tay ethnic homestay and enjoy dinner with “happy water”.

Day 3: Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast, walk to the Du Gia Waterfall, a hidden gem tucked into lush forest.

Continue riding through:

  • Duong Thuong Valley – dramatic mountain landscapes

  • Thai An Road – known for its rugged terrain and beautiful views

  • Bac Me area

Arrive in Ha Giang City in the afternoon.

16:00

Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.

Tour Price per Person (USD)

216 USD – SIC Group Tour

264 USD – Private Tour

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang

    • Luxury private-cabin sleeper bus (7:30–8:00 pm pickup)

    • Limousine bus (3:00–3:30 pm pickup)

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Homestay accommodation with private room

  • Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbike, fuel

  • Entrance fees

  • Protective gear: helmet, armor, raincoat

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (coffee, beer, etc.)
